desc:
🎣 FISH. FIGHT. COLLECT. 🎣

Dive into the depths of the ocean and discover mythical creatures to bring back to your aquarium.
Battle other players and prove you're the greatest fisherman out there.
Unlock new boats and weapons to take on powerful beasts and rival players.
Beware of the Kraken. It lurks in the deepest parts of the ocean. The battle will be brutal, but the rewards are worth it.

🔱 Can you conquer the ocean? 🔱
